description:
This file defines the OrderStatus class within the Opencart	o
amespace, extending the system's base Model class. It contains methods to retrieve individual order status details and a list of all order statuses, interacting with the database and cache.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Model class for handling order status data, including retrieval of specific and all order statuses.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific order status by its ID, filtering by current language.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all order statuses for the current language, utilizing caching for performance.
